verses.original: δὲ Τὸ πνεῦμα ῥητῶς λέγει ὅτι ἐν ὑστέροις καιροῖς τινες ἀποστήσονταί τῆς πίστεως προσέχοντες πλάνοις πνεύμασιν καὶ διδασκαλίαις δαιμονίων
verses.transliteration: de To pneuma rhētōs legei hoti en hysterois kairois tines apostēsontai tēs pisteōs prosechontes planois pneumasin kai didaskaliais daimoniōn
verses.literal: Now the Spirit expressly states that in later times some will abandon the faith to follow deceitful spirits and [the] teachings of demons

verses.original: ἐν ὑποκρίσει ψευδολόγων τὴν ἰδίαν συνείδησιν κεκαυστηριασμένων
verses.transliteration: en hypokrisei pseudologōn tēn idian syneidēsin kekaustēriasmenōn
verses.literal: influenced by [the] hypocrisy of liars - [whose] consciences are seared with a hot iron

verses.original: κωλυόντων γαμεῖν ἀπέχεσθαι βρωμάτων ἃ ὁ Θεὸς ἔκτισεν εἰς μετάλημψιν μετὰ εὐχαριστίας τοῖς πιστοῖς καὶ ἐπεγνωκόσι τὴν ἀλήθειαν
verses.transliteration: kōlyontōn gamein apechesthai brōmatōn ha ho Theos ektisen eis metalēmpsin meta eucharistias tois pistois kai epegnōkosi tēn alētheian
verses.literal: They will prohibit marriage [and require] abstinence from certain foods that - God has created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth

verses.original: ὅτι πᾶν κτίσμα Θεοῦ καλόν καὶ οὐδὲν λαμβανόμενον μετὰ εὐχαριστίας ἀπόβλητον
verses.transliteration: hoti pan ktisma Theou kalon kai ouden lambanomenon meta eucharistias apoblēton
verses.literal: For every creation of God [is] good and nothing that is received with thanksgiving should be rejected

verses.original: γὰρ ἁγιάζεται διὰ λόγου Θεοῦ καὶ ἐντεύξεως
verses.transliteration: gar hagiazetai dia logou Theou kai enteuxeōs
verses.literal: because it is sanctified by [the] word of God and prayer

verses.original: ὑποτιθέμενος Ταῦτα τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς ἔσῃ καλὸς διάκονος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐντρεφόμενος τοῖς λόγοις τῆς πίστεως καὶ τῆς καλῆς διδασκαλίας ᾗ παρηκολούθηκας
verses.transliteration: hypotithemenos Tauta tois adelphois esē kalos diakonos Christou Iēsou entrephomenos tois logois tēs pisteōs kai tēs kalēs didaskalias hē parēkolouthēkas
verses.literal: By pointing out these things to the brothers you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus nourished by the words - of faith and - sound instruction that you have followed

verses.original: δὲ παραιτοῦ Τοὺς βεβήλους καὶ γραώδεις μύθους δὲ γύμναζε σεαυτὸν πρὸς εὐσέβειαν
verses.transliteration: de paraitou Tous bebēlous kai graōdeis mythous de gymnaze seauton pros eusebeian
verses.literal: But reject - irreverent - silly myths Instead train yourself for godliness

verses.original: γὰρ ἡ σωματικὴ γυμνασία ἐστὶν πρὸς ὀλίγον ὠφέλιμος δὲ ἡ εὐσέβεια ἐστιν ὠφέλιμός πρὸς πάντα ἔχουσα ἐπαγγελίαν τῆς νῦν ζωῆς καὶ τῆς μελλούσης
verses.transliteration: gar hē sōmatikē gymnasia estin pros oligon ōphelimos de hē eusebeia estin ōphelimos pros panta echousa epangelian tēs nyn zōēs kai tēs mellousēs
verses.literal: For - physical exercise is of limited value but - godliness is valuable in every [way] holding promise for the present life and for the [one] to come

verses.original: πιστὸς ὁ λόγος καὶ ἄξιος πάσης ἀποδοχῆς
verses.transliteration: pistos ho logos kai axios pasēs apodochēs
verses.literal: [This is] a trustworthy - saying - worthy of full acceptance

verses.original: γὰρ Εἰς τοῦτο κοπιῶμεν καὶ ἀγωνιζόμεθα ὅτι ἠλπίκαμεν ἐπὶ ζῶντι Θεῷ ὅς ἐστιν Σωτὴρ πάντων ἀνθρώπων μάλιστα πιστῶν
verses.transliteration: gar Eis touto kopiōmen kai agōnizometha hoti ēlpikamen epi zōnti Theō hos estin Sōtēr pantōn anthrōpōn malista pistōn
verses.literal: - To this [end] we labor and strive because we have set our hope on [the] living God who is [the] Savior of everyone . . . [and] especially of those who believe

verses.original: Μηδείς καταφρονείτω σου τῆς νεότητος ἀλλὰ γίνου τύπος τῶν πιστῶν ἐν λόγῳ ἐν ἀναστροφῇ ἐν ἀγάπῃ ἐν πίστει ἐν ἁγνείᾳ
verses.transliteration: Mēdeis kataphroneitō sou tēs neotētos alla ginou typos tōn pistōn en logō en anastrophē en agapē en pistei en hagneia
verses.literal: {Let} no one despise your - youth but set an example for the believers in speech in conduct in love in faith in purity

verses.original: ἕως ἔρχομαι πρόσεχε τῇ ἀναγνώσει τῇ παρακλήσει τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ
verses.transliteration: heōs erchomai proseche tē anagnōsei tē paraklēsei tē didaskalia
verses.literal: Until I come devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture to exhortation [and] to teaching

verses.original: Μὴ ἀμέλει τοῦ χαρίσματος ἐν σοὶ ὃ ἐδόθη σοι διὰ προφητείας μετὰ ἐπιθέσεως τῶν χειρῶν τοῦ πρεσβυτερίου
verses.transliteration: Mē amelei tou charismatos en soi ho edothē soi dia prophēteias meta epitheseōs tōn cheirōn tou presbyteriou
verses.literal: {Do} not neglect the gift [that is] in you which was given you through [the] prophecy spoken [over you] at [the] laying on of the hands of the elders

verses.original: μελέτα ταῦτα ἴσθι ἐν τούτοις ἵνα σου ἡ προκοπὴ ᾖ φανερὰ πᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: meleta tauta isthi en toutois hina sou hē prokopē ē phanera pasin
verses.literal: Be diligent in these matters [and] absorbed in them so that your - progress will be evident to all

verses.original: ἔπεχε σεαυτῷ καὶ τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ ἐπίμενε αὐτοῖς γὰρ ποιῶν τοῦτο σώσεις καὶ σεαυτὸν καὶ τοὺς ἀκούοντάς σου
verses.transliteration: epeche seautō kai tē didaskalia epimene autois gar poiōn touto sōseis kai seauton kai tous akouontas sou
verses.literal: Pay close attention to your [life] and to [your] teaching Persevere in these things for by so doing . . . you will save both yourself and those who hear you
